name: vocametrix
description: Pronunciation practice, speech transcription, text-to-speech and language-learning tools.

interface.longDescription: Vocametrix helps you practise pronunciation and speaking in ChatGPT. Attach a recording to get phoneme-level pronunciation scores against a reference text (accuracy, fluency, completeness, prosody) in 30+ languages, compare your intonation and rhythm with a model recording, transcribe speech, and hear any text read aloud by a natural voice. You can also convert French to IPA, detect French phonemes, check the grammar of your writing, and build vocabulary with a conversational tutor. Requires a Vocametrix account.
defaultPrompt: Score my pronunciation of this sentence.
Read 'Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?' aloud with a French voice.
Give me the IPA for the French words grenouille and écureuil.

positive.description: Score the pronunciation of an attached recording against a reference text
positive.prompt: Here is a recording of me reading 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.' How good is my English pronunciation?
positive.expected_behavior: The attached recording is uploaded, then scored against the reference sentence. ChatGPT reports accuracy, fluency, completeness and prosody scores (0-100) and points out the words or phonemes that scored lowest. The reviewer attaches a WAV of themselves reading the sentence.

positive.description: Read a sentence aloud in the language it is written in
positive.prompt: Read 'Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?' aloud with a French voice.
positive.expected_behavior: A short audio clip of the sentence spoken by a French neural voice (fr-FR) is returned and can be played in the conversation.

positive.prompt: Give me the IPA transcription of the French words grenouille and écureuil, with syllable marks.
positive.expected_behavior: Each word is returned with its IPA transcription and syllable boundaries.

positive.description: Check the grammar of a sentence written by a learner
positive.prompt: I'm learning English. Check the grammar of: 'She don't like apples and yesterday he go to school.'
positive.expected_behavior: The two agreement and tense errors are listed with their severity, and a corrected sentence is returned.

positive.prompt: I'm a French speaker learning English. Quiz me on food vocabulary, I'm an adult.
positive.expected_behavior: The tutor starts a vocabulary exercise on food for an adult French speaker learning English and waits for the learner's answer.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is out of scope
negative.prompt: Listen to my voice recording and tell me whether I have a voice disorder.
Connected with the account that has no credits: score my pronunciation of 'Good morning, everyone.'
Book me a table for two in a restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Usage is billed to the user's existing Vocametrix account.

publication.release_notes: Refocused on pronunciation practice and language learning. Clinical voice measures, stuttering classification and therapy tools are no longer offered in ChatGPT.
